basic_details.job_title: CUSAT Technical Assistant Grade I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Under CUSAT Recruitment 2026, Cochin University of Science & Technology (CUSAT) is filling one Technical Assistant Grade I post on a contract basis in its Department of Instrumentation. Candidates apply online on the CUSAT recruitment portal (recruit.cusat.ac.in). The last date for online submission is 19 November 2026, and the hardcopy must be submitted by 26 November 2026. The application fee is INR 950 for General candidates and INR 195 for SC/ST candidates.

how_to_apply: The application has two stages: an online application on the CUSAT recruitment portal (recruit.cusat.ac.in), and then a hardcopy. You can create an account using the portal's Register option, and you can sign in again later through Candidate Login. Submit online by 19 November 2026 and submit the hardcopy by 26 November 2026. The notice does not mention the address for sending the hardcopy.

content_sections.heading: About CUSAT Technical Assistant Grade I
content_sections.text: Cochin University of Science & Technology (CUSAT) is a university in Kochi, Kerala. It handles its recruitments on its own portal, recruit.cusat.ac.in, which is run under the Registrar. This post is in the university's Department of Instrumentation.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Educational Qualifications & Experience: Diploma in Computer Application/Diploma in Computer Hardware and Networking No of Vacancy: 01 Consolidated Pay per month (₹) : ₹31,020/- Age limit (as on 01.01.2026): 18 - 40 Years. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply online for CUSAT Technical Assistant Grade I?
faq.answer: The last date for online submission is 19 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for the hardcopy submission?
faq.answer: The hardcopy of the CUSAT Technical Assistant Grade I application must be submitted by 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for CUSAT Technical Assistant Grade I?
faq.answer: The fee is INR 950 for General candidates and INR 195 for SC/ST candidates. For foreign candidates, the notice shows the fee as "NA".

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply for CUSAT Technical Assistant Grade I?
faq.answer: Apply online on the CUSAT recruitment portal, recruit.cusat.ac.in, by 19 November 2026. Then submit the hardcopy by 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Is the CUSAT Technical Assistant Grade I post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The post is on contract. The notice describes it as "Technical Assistant Grade I (Contract) in the Department of Instrumentation".

faq.question: Q6. In which department is the CUSAT Technical Assistant Grade I post?
faq.answer: The post is in the Department of Instrumentation at Cochin University of Science & Technology.
